editorial.name: Envato Elements
editorial.descriptionZh: 订阅制的素材库，把视频模板、库存视频、音乐、字体、图形和 AI 生成工具打包，按月无限下载。
editorial.takeawayZh: 订阅后无限下载视频模板、音乐、字体与 AI 素材
editorial.noteZh: 顶栏是 envato logo、All Items 下拉与搜索框，右侧绿色按钮是 Get unlimited downloads。下面一条绿色横幅写着 Google Gemini Omni Flash: Now on Envato 并配 Start Creating 按钮。主视觉左边写 Riff until it's right with Your all-in-one creative asset toolkit，右边一张白卡标着 From $16.50/month、Unlimited downloads of 29+ million creative assets、AI Tools: video, image, audio、Lifetime commercial license 与 Subscribe to download 按钮。往下 Every type of asset, for any type of project 区块里排着 Cards：Create with our AI Tools、Video Templates 150,000+、Stock Photos 16.4M+、Royalty-Free Music 350,000+。

reasons.statement: 站上交付的是需要订阅付费才能下载的素材与模板，行为是订阅购买，因此按素材、模板与服务市场归类；它同时也是一座横跨照片、视频、音乐、字体、3D 的素材库，若按素材类型归类会强行压到单一子类。
